title: P2 control.revert: request
description: Body of P2 control.revert: revert of the seat's operations in one transaction: the seat's stops are released, pending action requests, control cards and pinned tasks not yet started are canceled; the revert does not touch executed actions (MGR-15). With since the operator with admin:farm calls it, only through farmctl; with incident the operator or a person of the tenant with hold.release.

since.description: Revert of all seat operations after this instant.

incident.description: Revert of the seat operations on one incident.
